about.label: About us
about.title: Traditional Czech supplier of printed and plain tapes
about.lead: For more than 30 years we have helped companies pack their shipments securely and build a strong brand directly on packaging materials. We offer custom-printed adhesive tapes as well as plain neutral tapes.
about.body1_tooltip: We do not only manufacture adhesive tapes, we also produce the films ourselves, which gives us a significant competitive advantage when raw materials are in short supply.
about.body1_suffix: allows us to respond flexibly to the needs of both small e-shops and large industrial enterprises. We pride ourselves on precise printing (up to 8 colours), premium adhesive quality (HOT MELT and Akryl) and fast delivery throughout the Czech Republic and the European Union.
about.body1: Our modern production facility allows us to respond flexibly to the needs of both small e-shops and large industrial enterprises. We pride ourselves on precise printing (up to 8 colours), premium adhesive quality (Hot Melt, Acrylic) and fast delivery throughout the Czech Republic.
about.body2: Thanks to ISO 9001 certified processes and the use of ecological, sustainable materials, we are a reliable partner for more than 300 active customers.

lepidla.label: Selection guide
lepidla.title: Which adhesive should you choose?
lepidla.hot_melt_text: The ideal choice for cooler environments and unheated warehouses. It bonds to the substrate extremely quickly and strongly immediately after application. It cannot be easily removed from stretch wrap.
lepidla.acryl_text: Ensures quiet, comfortable unwinding appreciated in large packing halls. Highly resistant to UV radiation and ageing, making it the perfect choice for long-term goods storage.

sustainability.label: Ecology & sustainability
sustainability.title: Sustainable packaging without compromising quality
sustainability.subtitle: We supply packaging materials that give raw materials a second life. Get a fully functional solution for your shipping with minimal environmental impact.
sustainability.card1_title: Sustainable materials with a second life
sustainability.card1_text: Our range includes eco-friendly kraft paper tapes, BOPET tape from recycled PET bottles, and films with PCR/PIR waste. We return plastics and paper to the loop without losing strength.
sustainability.card2_text: We use only water-based acrylic dispersion and HOT MELT technology without solvents. No toxic vapours, safe for packing-line staff, with reliable instant and long-term adhesion.
sustainability.card3_text: We help B2B partners cut packaging carbon footprint, meet environmental standards and hit ESG goals. A responsible solution that strengthens your brand with clients and auditors.

benefits.eco_title: ECO+ tapes: regenerated from our own production
benefits.eco_text: ECO+ film is made from post-industrial waste from BOPP film production: the material is returned to the loop immediately. Choose 50%, 80% or 100% regenerated content with the same strength as a standard tape, with no eco surcharge. Available as Akryl or HOT MELT, plain or printed.
benefits.glue_text: Tapes with an increased adhesive layer (33% and 20% respectively) and the option of a stronger film than standard, designed for very demanding applications such as heavy parcels, poor-quality cardboard or dusty environments. They bond extremely firmly to cardboard.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Answers before you order
faq.subtitle: Common questions about printing, lead times and materials. Not sure? Contact us, we will help.

0.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
0.a: For BOPP tapes 360 pcs (Acrylic) or 504 pcs (HOT MELT); for paper and BOPET tapes the minimum depends individually on the print and crepe layer.

1.q: How long does it take to produce printed tape?
1.a: The standard lead time is 3 to 4 weeks from approval of the artwork and order. For urgent jobs we try to speed up delivery.

2.q: Can I order tape without printing?
2.a: Yes. We supply the same quality tapes without print, ideal for stock or immediate packaging.

3.q: What is the difference between HOT MELT and Acrylic?
3.a: HOT MELT bonds quickly and firmly even in the cold, ideal for warehouses and dispatch. Acrylic is quieter when unwinding and more UV-resistant, ideal for longer storage. More in Which adhesive to choose?.

4.a: We do not produce a physical sample with your print. We are happy to send free samples of materials and adhesives we keep from previous jobs, so you can test tape quality and adhesion on your cartons before ordering.

5.q: Which print technologies do you offer?
5.a: Flexo print up to 8 colours and rotogravure up to 10 colours including high-quality reverse print. We recommend the right technology based on colours, volume and print quality needs.

grafika.q: Will you prepare the artwork for me?
grafika.a: Yes. We need your logo (ideally vector PDF, AI or EPS), optional text and colour idea (exact Pantone shades). Before production we send a graphic preview for approval.
grafika.search: artwork design logo preview pdf ai eps pantone

sirka.q: What tape widths and lengths do you make?
sirka.a: We supply a wide range of sizes for hand and machine packing. Standard widths: 25 mm, 38 mm, 50 mm, 75 mm and 100 mm. Hand-roll lengths: 66 m, 100 m, 132 m and 180 m. Machine lengths (packing lines): 330 m, 660 m, 990 m and 1000 m.

eko.q: Do you offer sustainable / ECO tapes?
eko.a: Yes, the ECO+ range (recycled BOPP), paper tapes and other sustainable options. Details are in the Sustainable tapes assortment.
eko.search: eco recycled sustainable paper fsc circular

stroje.q: Are the tapes suitable for machine packing?
stroje.a: Yes. Based on adhesive and material we recommend a variant for hand dispensers or for automatic packing lines.

doprava.q: How do shipping and invoicing work?
doprava.a: We deliver across Czechia and abroad. Shipping and payment terms are confirmed in the quote based on volume and destination.
doprava.search: shipping invoicing delivery czech eu price

skladovani.a: Ideally dry, away from direct sun, at normal room temperature. Acrylic tapes handle longer storage better; with intensive use we recommend consuming HOT MELT sooner.

opakovat.q: Can I reorder with the same print?
opakovat.a: Yes. We archive all approved printing plates. A repeat order with the same design can therefore proceed immediately without a new approval round.
opakovat.search: repeat order reprint same artwork plate archive

matrice.q: Do I pay for the printing plate again on a repeat order?
matrice.a: No. We keep your approved printing plate. Repeat production with the same artwork runs automatically with no further prep fees.
matrice.search: printing plate fee repeat order archive forme

cena.q: What affects the price of printed tape?
cena.a: Price depends on material, adhesive, roll width and length, number of colours, print technology and total volume. Send an inquiry and we will prepare a concrete quote.
cena.search: price quote calculation cost per roll

papir-vs-bopp.q: When should I choose paper tape instead of BOPP?
papir-vs-bopp.a: Paper tape suits eco packaging, recyclable cartons and brands that want a natural look. BOPP resists moisture better and is often more cost-effective at higher volumes. We are happy to advise for your process.

bezpecnostni.q: Can you make security or warning tapes?
bezpecnostni.a: Yes, warning prints, Fragile, Vorsicht Glas, VOID / tamper-evident and logistics texts. We prepare the design to your instructions and language variants.

zmena-grafiky.q: What if I need to change artwork after approval?
zmena-grafiky.a: Until plate-making / printing starts, changes are usually still possible. After production starts, changes may not be possible without extra cost and a new lead time, so check the preview carefully.

jadro.q: What core / cardboard tube do you use?
jadro.a: We normally supply rolls with a standard paper core suitable for hand and machine unwinders. For sustainability and ESG goals we also offer tapes with a recycled-paper core.
jadro.search: core tube diameter cardboard recycled esg

zahranici.a: Yes. We ship to the EU and beyond, shipping and terms are agreed by destination and volume.

odstranitelna.q: Do you have tapes that remove cleanly?
odstranitelna.a: Yes, removable tapes for cases where you do not want adhesive residue. We recommend the right type for the surface. See Removable tapes in the assortment.

vice-jazyku.q: Can the tape text be in multiple languages?
vice-jazyku.a: Yes. We often combine a logo with logistics texts in Czech, German, English and other languages, designed to stay readable when repeated along the tape.

prilnavost.q: What does adhesion to steel mean?
prilnavost.a: It shows how strongly the tape sticks to a surface right after application. A higher value means the tape holds more firmly on the carton and is less likely to peel off on its own.

pevnost-tahu.a: It measures the tape’s mechanical resistance to breaking under strong tension. A higher number means the tape is less likely to snap when packing demanding or heavy shipments.

taznost.a: The percentage shows how much the tape can stretch before it breaks. Low elongation keeps the box firm without sagging; higher elongation helps the tape absorb shocks during transport.

bopp-pasky.title: BOPP tapes

bopp-pasky.intro: BOPP tapes are the standard for everyday packing in manufacturing, logistics and e-commerce. Biaxially oriented polypropylene film delivers an excellent price-performance ratio, availability in acrylic and hot melt versions, and a wide range of widths and colours.

properties.Chemical resistance: Resistant to solvents, oils and harsh environments.
